description: This file defines the InstalledAppsCache class, which manages a cache of installed applications on an Android device. It listens for package installation and removal broadcasts, updates the cache accordingly, and provides methods to check if a package is installed.

classes.name: InstalledAppsCache
classes.description: A singleton class that caches installed app information, listens for package add/remove broadcasts, and updates the cache accordingly.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a given package name is in the installed apps cache.

methods.name: loadInstalledApps
methods.description: Loads the list of installed applications asynchronously.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents for package added or removed events.

methods.name: onPackageAdded
methods.description: Updates cache when a package is added or replaced.

methods.name: onPackageRemoved
methods.description: Updates cache when a package is removed.
